text:
Samir (Solutions): quick sync on Quartz enterprise POC — need owners + blockers for staging cutover. Target dry-run: 2024-06-05. Items: network peering, staging creds, API contract/schema, SSO + auth, perf SLOs, security review. Can owners confirm and call out blockers? TL;DR: signoffs by EOD Fri please.

Maya Patel: I can own staging creds and test accounts. Will open JIRA tickets for creds + test data (QUZ-142, QUZ-143). Need env names we should use.

Jin (eng): On API schema — PR in flight (#4567). Can we get sample payloads from SE? Also we need to pick a stable model variant for perf: planning to use redwood/redwood-small-q4 quantized.

Diego R.: Filed network peering request with cloud team (NET-981). Waiting on CIDR from infra. @Maya can you confirm the CIDR we should request? Also need VPC egress rules for telemetry.

Tara - SE: I'll drop sample payloads here by EOD today. Success criteria proposal: 95% requests under 300ms p95 and embedding quality >=0.88 on our eval set. Also need SSO flow validated end-to-end. Is that acceptable? :thinking_face:

Samir (Solutions): That looks reasonable. Jin — can you add perf harness to the PR (simple k6 script + tokenized load)? Diego — CIDR we expect is 10.50.0.0/16, can you action NET-981 with that? Maya confirm? Also we need a security review before cutover.

Maya Patel: Confirm CIDR 10.50.0.0/16. I'll tag security and add SSO test accounts. Will attach env names in QUZ-142.

Lina (security): Quick note — we need a data flow diagram and retention policy attached to the security ticket (SEC-78) before we can approve production access. Also confirm whether logs contain PII.

Jin (eng): Adding perf harness to PR now. Minimal example to run locally:

```bash
# run perf against staging
k6 run perf/quartz-poc-script.js --vus 50 --duration 2m 
```

And sample curl to smoke-test endpoint:

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/redwood-small-q4","input":"hello"}'
```

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for staging: quartz-poc/staging @ 2024-06-03T02:00:00Z (build 20240603.1)

Diego R.: I'll be available to coordinate peering on Wed 10:00-12:00 PST. If cloud team needs a live handoff ping me in #eng-infra.

Samir (Solutions): Great — I'll consolidate owners and send an updated checklist to the customer tonight. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Will follow up in QUZ-142/143 with creds + env names.

Jin (eng): PR link here once ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4567

Tara - SE: Sharing payloads in thread -> attaching test-set v1 in a follow-up message.

Samir (Solutions): Final ask — please add any hard blockers to this thread. If none by EOD Fri we'll proceed with dry-run schedule.
